parameters.content:
## 1. Input
Fill in the form (or open the form URL). Set **SHEET_ID**, **CLAUDE_MODEL** and your business description once in **Config**.

parameters.formDescription: Finds low-hanging-fruit keywords and the questions people ask, then saves a prioritised backlog for the blog writer.

values.placeholder: one per line, e.g. n8n automation

values.fieldLabel: What do you sell and to whom?

assignments.name: BUSINESS_DESCRIPTION
assignments.value: Describe your business, your offer and your ideal customer here.

parameters.content:
## 2. Collect keywords (DataForSEO Labs)
Suggestions + related keywords per seed, ideas for all seeds together, and the keywords your site already ranks **4-20** for (striking distance).

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify([{ keyword: $json.seed, location_name: $json.location_name, language_name: $json.language_name, include_seed_keyword: true, limit: 200 }]) }}

={{ JSON.stringify([{ keyword: $('Prepare seeds').item.json.seed, location_name: $('Prepare seeds').first().json.location_name, language_name: $('Prepare seeds').first().json.language_name, depth: 2, limit: 200 }]) }}

={{ JSON.stringify([{ keywords: $('Prepare seeds').first().json.seeds, location_name: $('Prepare seeds').first().json.location_name, language_name: $('Prepare seeds').first().json.language_name, limit: 300 }]) }}

={{ JSON.stringify([{ target: $('Prepare seeds').first().json.domain, location_name: $('Prepare seeds').first().json.location_name, language_name: $('Prepare seeds').first().json.language_name, limit: 300, filters: [["ranked_serp_element.serp_item.rank_group", ">=", 4], "and", ["ranked_serp_element.serp_item.rank_group", "<=", 20]], order_by: ["keyword_data.keyword_info.search_volume,desc"] }]) }}

parameters.content:
## 3. Pick low-hanging fruit + check Google
Scores every keyword (volume, difficulty, intent, CPC, striking distance), keeps the easy wins, then reads the live SERP: People Also Ask, competitors and forum/UGC results (= beatable SERP).

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify([{ keyword: $json.keyword, location_name: $('Prepare seeds').first().json.location_name, language_name: $('Prepare seeds').first().json.language_name, depth: 10, people_also_ask_click_depth: 1 }]) }}

parameters.content:
## 4. Position + save
Claude clusters the keywords and decides the angle that sets us apart from the top results. Rows land in the **Keywords** tab with status `ready`.
